summary: Verified IslandHop admin User Management upgrades + Safety & Disputes merge end-to-end. Backend pytest (11/11 passing): user_type filter (all/customer/driver/merchant), POST /api/admin/users/{id}/set-status transitions (active/paused/restricted), auth gate (paused/restricted -> login 403 with support msg; active -> login 200; authenticated /api/auth/me returns 403 for paused via get_current_user_from_request), self-pause blocked (400), invalid status (400), non-admin (403). UI verified on preview: Users tab has user-type-filter with buttons all/customer/merchant/driver - filter counts all=56, customer=18, driver=1 (matches expected preview DB). Each row shows view-profile-btn / message-user-btn / pause-user-btn / restrict-user-btn (approve-user-btn only when status != active). Created throwaway customer, clicked pause -> row status text changed to 'paused' and approve-user-btn appeared; clicked view-profile-btn -> dialog opened; approve restored active state and pause button returned. Safety & Disputes tab (admin-tab-safety) present as single tab labeled 'Safety & Disputes' with badge '113' (= 86 frauds + 27 claims). Old admin-tab-fraud/claims/disputes are removed. safety-subtabs wrapper contains safety-subtab-fraud/claims/disputes; switching between them renders Fraud Review Queue, Claims list, and Customer Disputes ('No open disputes').

minor.issue: Response objects still include `hashed_password` field for every user (visible to admin caller). Should be scrubbed from list response to reduce hash exposure surface.

action_items: (Security minor) Scrub hashed_password (and any other secrets like session_token) from GET /api/admin/users list response, matching the scrubbing already done for admin/records/users.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still ~10.6k lines — user status/auth-gate logic (login, set-status, _account_block_detail, get_current_user_from_request) is scattered. Consider extracting an auth/user_status module.

_account_block_detail is duplicated in intent across two callsites (line 137 and 426/440). Fine, but ensure any future statuses (e.g. deleted, pending_verification) get handled in one place to avoid drift.

POST /api/admin/users/{id}/set-status accepts only active/paused/restricted but the DB field can be any string historically. Consider a one-off migration or a fallback that treats unknown legacy values as 'active' explicitly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all Users filter + status flows + Safety & Disputes verified)

test_credentials: Admin admin.qa@islandhop-demo.com / AdminQA1234! (works). Register requires public-domain email (used @gmail.com).
seed_data_creation: Two throwaway customers created for testing: qa_iter33_<ts>@gmail.com (backend tests) and qa_ui_iter33_<ts>@gmail.com (UI test). Both left in DB with status=active as of end of run - safe to ignore or delete later.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin User Management: user_type filter and status controls fully working. Key testids: admin-tab-users, user-type-filter, user-type-{all|customer|merchant|driver}, view-profile-btn-<id>, message-user-btn-<id>, approve-user-btn-<id> (only when status!=active), pause-user-btn-<id>, restrict-user-btn-<id>. Backend: GET /api/admin/users?user_type=... (all/customer/merchant/driver), POST /api/admin/users/{id}/set-status body {status:'active'|'paused'|'restricted'}. Auth gate enforced at login (POST /api/auth/login -> 403) and on every authenticated request via get_current_user_from_request (-> 403). Safety & Disputes: single tab admin-tab-safety replaces old fraud/claims/disputes tabs, safety-subtabs wrapper with safety-subtab-{fraud|claims|disputes}, badge = open_frauds+open_claims. To authenticate in Playwright: POST /api/auth/login then localStorage.setItem('token', access_token) then goto /admin.
rca of the issue: N/A - feature verification, no functional bug found. Minor security hygiene item: /api/admin/users response leaks hashed_password.
